title: Motor overload relay tripped
summary: The thermal overload relay opened: the contactor drops out and the motor cannot restart until the relay is reset and the cause removed.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: The thermal overload relay opened: the contactor drops out and the motor cannot restart until the relay is reset and the cause removed.

repair: Check the overload setting against the motor rating plate
troubleshooting.explanation: The overload relay protects the motor winding against sustained overcurrent; resetting it without removing the cause leads to repeated trips or motor damage.
